subject: FB-3b: Generate ON-self-learning KB for 5 pilot repos — inject into graph + export AGENTS.md
description: Corrected ON-arm KB generation (supersedes the blocked FB-3 approach; see note-mqfh9nmj87j). SINGLE ON arm = ON-self-learning only. For each of the 5 pilot repos in bench/featurebench-kb/pilot-manifest.json (pandas@82fa2715, astropy@b0db0daa, sphinx@e347e59c, seaborn@7001ebe7, sympy@c1097516): (1) clone from canonical GitHub at the pinned base_commit into a scratch dir; (2) run scripts/onboard.js --repo <abs> (full mine->learn; the read-only learner validates mined candidates against source — this IS the self-learning filter); (3) CRITICALLY update the KB: run scripts/onboard-learn.js --repo <abs> --inject --confirm so the validated notes are injected as graph nodes in that repo's workspace (NOT a bare bundle — the KB must actually be updated, per user); (4) export the per-repo KB block via scripts/export-kb.js --repo <abs> into bench/featurebench-kb/<repo>.selflearn.AGENTS.md. Update bench/featurebench-kb/README.md: single ON arm, drop-in instruction for the Windows host (place <repo>.selflearn.AGENTS.md as AGENTS.md before running that repo's instances for the ON arm; OFF runs with no AGENTS.md). API-billed onboarding x5 repos — authorized; stay to the 5-repo manifest. If a repo's mine->learn yields empty/degenerate KB, record it rather than faking. Commit bench/featurebench-kb/ on the attempt branch. Verified prerequisite: foreign-repo onboarding works (cosma c0bd3682/13); onboard.js needs NO probes (probes are only for onboard-loop.js).
